training_code_diagnosis.cache_group_selection: corrected logits subtract log(legal UPDATE count) from legal UPDATE logits; deterministic action compares summed corrected probability mass for KEEP vs UPDATE (tie -> KEEP), then uses within-UPDATE raw-logit argmax.
training_code_diagnosis.long_value_actor_participation: NO: Long-Value Critic is fit separately to realized return-to-go with a disjoint optimizer; _update_macro Actor advantage is the Macro SMDP GAE.
training_code_diagnosis.macro_n2_target_formula: for nonterminal k: R_k + γ^{d_k}R_{k+1} + γ^{d_k+d_{k+1}}V(s_{k+2}); terminal tails omit unavailable bootstrap terms.
training_code_diagnosis.macro_smdp_gae_formula: δ_k = R_k + γ^d V(s_{k+1})·(1−done) − V(s_k); A_k = δ_k + (γλ)^d·(1−done)·A_{k+1}, with actual Macro duration d.
training_code_diagnosis.state_specific_training_advantage_or_gra: UNKNOWN: no state-action Macro advantage or per-candidate gradient for these saved training decisions is recorded in the reused artifacts; no training was repeated.
